name: FancyScrollView
src_typeComment: A virtualized, optionally curved scroll view — distinct from the existing lightweight ScrollSnap, which has neither. Only ever instantiates enough cells to cover the visible viewport (+ a small buffer), no matter how large itemCount is, recycling them by re-populating via OnUpdateCell as the index range in view changes — this is the actual point of the tool, for lists too large to just lay out every item at once. Wraps a real ScrollRect for input/inertia rather than reimplementing drag physics.

src_serialized.name: cellPrefab
src_serialized.tooltip: Template cloned into the pool. Not a GameObject in the scene — instantiate it fresh per pooled slot.

src_serialized.name: cellSize
src_serialized.tooltip: Size of one cell along the scroll axis.

src_serialized.name: bufferCells
src_serialized.tooltip: Extra cells kept pooled beyond the visible count, so cells scrolling just offscreen are already instantiated.

src_serialized.name: carouselMinScale
src_serialized.tooltip: Only used by the Carousel curve — how small the furthest-from-center cells shrink to.

src_serialized.name: carouselMinAlpha
src_serialized.tooltip: Only used by the Carousel curve — how transparent the furthest-from-center cells become.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<int, RectTransform> OnUpdateCell = new UnityEvent<int, RectTransform>()
src_members.name: UnityEvent
src_members.comment: The logical item index, and the pooled cell instance now assigned to show it — bind your data here.

src_members.name: SetItemCount
src_members.comment: Sets (or changes) the total logical item count — resizes the scroll content to the full virtual length and grows the cell pool if needed (the pool never shrinks below what a previous, larger itemCount already required, since re-instantiating later is wasted work for a size that likely recurs).
